article.intro: This **Minecraft clan name generator** makes names for factions, PvP clans, Bedwars and Skywars teams, and friend groups on an SMP. Whether you're founding a faction or just need a name for your friends' corner of a server, a group name gives everyone something to rally behind.

sections.heading: Minecraft faction, clan and team names
sections.content:
Minecraft clan names change with the group: factions sound like orders, PvP clans sound fierce, and friend groups sound like friends.

  • Factions: on factions servers, groups claim land, build bases and raid each other, so faction names sound like an order or a pact: the Obsidian Pact, the Void Order.
  • PvP clans: names that look good next to a kill feed: Void Reapers, Wither Titans.
  • Teams: for Bedwars, Skywars and server events, short and loud.
  • Friends: for your group on an SMP, something you'd actually say out loud: the Redstone Rascals, the Dirt Hut Gang.

sections.heading: How to choose a Minecraft clan name
sections.content:
A good Minecraft clan name is short enough to abbreviate into a clan tag and fits the server's rules.

  • Make it short enough for a tag. Many servers show a clan tag of a few letters next to your name, so pick something with a good abbreviation.
  • Check the server's rules before you pick something edgy: most servers ban offensive clan names.
  • Match your members' names for bonus points.

For the server itself, try the Minecraft Server Name Generator. For clans in other games, try the Clan Name Generator.

For everything else in Minecraft, see all the Minecraft name generators.

More for your Minecraft world: usernames and tool and weapon names.

For groups outside Minecraft, the Guild Name Generator has fantasy guilds and companies.

faqs.question: What's a good Minecraft faction name?
faqs.answer: Something that sounds like an order or a pact: choose Faction for names like the Obsidian Pact or the Void Order.

faqs.question: What are good Bedwars team names?
faqs.answer: Short, loud ones you can shout in voice chat. Choose Team.

faqs.question: What should we call our SMP friend group?
faqs.answer: Something you'd actually say: choose Friends for names like the Redstone Rascals or the Dirt Hut Gang.

faqs.question: What are good Skywars team names?
faqs.answer: Short and fast, like the Bedwars ones: choose Team for names you can shout in voice chat.
